data.name: Mahipal
data.long_meaning: Mahipal is a Sanskrit name for the Hindu deity Mahadev, who is the god of war and destruction. The name Mahipal is derived from the words 'maha' meaning great and 'pal' meaning protector or guardian. It is believed that Mahipal protects his followers from their enemies and helps them overcome obstacles in life.
